SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Lord Jesus, Thee we behold In Thy glory exalted, And to Thee our heart’s praise Ascends now with holy joy.

2.

Every trace of scorn and mocking, Heaped upon Thy head here, Every depth of sorrow and pain Has been recompensed with glory there.

3.

On Thy cross Thou wast alone, No comforter was near. Exalted now in glory Thou art acclaimed by heaven’s host.

4.

Though Thy God forsook Thee, Hid Himself from Thy woe, In Thy countenance once smitten Now His glory we see.

5.

With admiration Thee we behold, Lord Jesus, on Thy path. Thou, Lamb of God, alone art worthy, Earth and heaven acclaim Thee.

Text: Efter Gazing on Thee, Lord, in glory av Cenita Thompson, 1881. Musik: Rhineland av Wilhelm Brockhaus, 1888. 8.7.8.7
